targetControlledShape: Closed square pedestal profile with four shallow actual Boolean recesses and attached stone lotus carving; central solid core checked by rays.
Broad closed six-sided curved stone roof with thick downturned lip, raised hips, real chipped edge/fissure geometry and spherical finial.
Six deep framed window openings with actual connected dark cast lattice, recessed thin luminous panes and stone piers.
Heavy hexagonal platform with real carved floral frieze and surface-fitted lotus receiver/crown relief.
Individually authored irregular plinth courses and 3D mineral/lichen age variation, using unchanged existing CC0 metric granite maps.

capturedSourceRole.title: Japanese Toro
capturedSourceRole.author: 3dlunatic
capturedSourceRole.licenseRequirements: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
capturedSourceRole.sourceDescription: Japanese Toro is a stone lantern. I took the photos on my trip to Japan, and created this with Ajisoft PhotoScan. It needs a little cleaning up and retopology.
capturedSourceRole.attribution: Japanese Toro by 3dlunatic, licensed CC BY 4.0, via Sketchfab and the public Objaverse dataset. Hybrid cleanup, cropping, retopology and authored stonework are documented in the derived asset report.

nativeIntegration.API: Same exported loadIslandLanternStone / buildIslandStoneLantern functions and existing anchor/parentMatrix/uniformScale/maps/glowMaterial arguments. Await the new loader to prepare the GLB. All current caller options are retained.
dependencies: Existing original scene07 granite crop maps
nativeIntegration.placement: Native adapter performs a declared3D normalisation: actual minimum Y at0, height4.05, maximum roof plan half-width1.06. Parent controls live scene integration.
nativeIntegration.lighting: Existing glowMaterial is reused when supplied. Native adapter adds no light; practical centre metadata is returned for the parent. Standalone Cycles uses an actual internal point light.
nativeIntegration.nativePBR: Original map/normal/roughness plus metric UVs and exported vertex age RGB; shader/material calibration is declared in asset156.json.

remaining: Exact HD carved motifs and weathering pattern are not a verified match.
R05 age is procedural/geometry-derived rather than scanned surface colour, and may still need tuning in live scene07 lighting.
Standalone camera/light is independent of the source07 camera/light; no native scene07 acceptance or integration is claimed.
